analysis:
Every unit in this batch is documentation: seven new changelog.d/*.md files and an edit to docs/architecture/hardware-support.md. The patch contains no executable code, so I found no concrete security regression.

Behavior the prose describes, with the implementing code outside this batch and unverified:
- Cluster pairs: a coordinator-decided registration timeout no longer counts toward the three-strike fallback to local serving. A set-aside pair is re-offered after an hour. This touches availability (A-018) only. The coordinator, not the provider, decides these ends, so the change does not appear to widen an attack surface, but the provider rule itself is not visible here.
- Qwen3.8 27B pairs: the speculative assistant is now excluded from public cluster plans under mtp_mode auto. The leader runs the save-time rules against a coordinator's approval before stopping a part or sending anything over the cable. This tightens the public-serving qualification boundary (T-052, T-054 area).
- Release runtime facts: releases compute cluster_runtime facts and a pair-serving grant per model. The registration includes the block only when a per-environment repository variable is true. GLM-5.3-Flash and Qwen3.8-27B are declared public by owner decision. The changelog admits that no pipeline ran on two M5 Ultras and that GLM has no tensor-parallel cross-cable record. Public qualification resting on owner decision rather than parity evidence is a policy and qualification-claim point (A-017, T-054, T-056). The coordinator side, which auto-approves a build's two-Mac clusters, is platform-owned and not visible here. The next review should check that source and that the CI path cannot be abused to inject facts.
- Part heartbeat: the part now writes ~/.darkbloom/cluster-setup/part-health.json. File permissions and ownership are unverified (TB-003/TB-012 local same-UID context).
- KV reslice floors: resliceGrants gives each slot its floor before the proportional split. The refusal fires only when the floors together exceed the budget. A newcomer's own floor is checked only at engine assembly and can still fail closed with no_kv_headroom. This is a memory-admission availability change (T-016/T-029 area). The docs state that shrink and regrowth never drop a slot below its floor, and the code is not in this batch.
- min_p: the sampling parameter now applies on a single Mac. No security impact is apparent.

Integration should read the actual implementation of these claims.
